title: Seceda & the Dolomites
route: Brescia → Ortisei → Seceda → Sella Ronda → Selva
introTitle: Into the heart of the Dolomites.
intro: One of the biggest scenic days of The Long Way Around begins with an early drive from Brescia to Ortisei. After riding the cableways to Seceda for panoramic views across the Dolomites, the journey continues around the Sella massif through a series of mountain passes, villages and valleys, finishing with Passo Gardena in the late-afternoon light before spending the night in Selva di Val Gardena.

stops.name: Brescia
stops.description: Leave Brescia early and head north toward the Dolomites.

stops.name: Seceda Cableways — Ortisei
stops.description: Park in Ortisei and begin the cableway journey up to Seceda.

stops.name: Seceda
stops.description: Take in the dramatic ridgeline and panoramic views from high above Val Gardena.

stops.name: Seceda Cableways — Ortisei
stops.description: Ride back down to Ortisei and begin the scenic driving loop.

stops.name: Passo Sella
stops.description: The first major mountain pass of the Sella loop, beneath the dramatic walls of the Sella massif.

stops.name: Passo Pordoi
stops.description: Continue around the Sella massif over Passo Pordoi.

stops.name: Arabba
stops.description: Descend from Passo Pordoi through the mountain village of Arabba.

stops.name: Passo Campolongo
stops.description: Climb from Arabba over Passo Campolongo toward Alta Badia.

stops.name: Corvara
stops.description: Pass through Corvara in the heart of Alta Badia before the final climb of the loop.

stops.name: Passo Gardena
stops.description: Save the final major pass for late-afternoon and golden-hour views across the Dolomites.

stops.name: Selva di Val Gardena
stops.description: Descend from Passo Gardena into Selva di Val Gardena and settle in for the night in the heart of the Dolomites.
